text:
Mute clouds rain silent waters in white fleeces; the day passes with majesty under cold shadow, while the hidden sun looks from balconies.


Hearts sustained by burning courage do not admit winter, for the Spanish monarchy pours equal strength into bulls and lances.


Jarama's glory, its broad brow wet and burning with grim rage, spills its purple life in blood.


Flattering Spain's great king, the snow-darkened storm applauded the arm, ash shaft, and cane.

translation.title: Silent Waters Rain in Fleeces
